## Home — https://bridgelandsdetached.com/

A detached-home collection at Bridgelands has not been officially confirmed by Arista Homes, Deco Homes, or Opus Homes as of August 2026. Based on the same builder trio's other joint communities — SouthCal in Caledon and The Castle Mile in Brampton, both of which include detached homes alongside townhomes — a comparable detached collection at Bridgelands is a reasonable expectation pending official confirmation.

Bridgelands is a "Coming Soon" master-planned community near Weston Road and Teston Road in Woodbridge, Vaughan, Ontario, developed by Arista Homes, Deco Homes, and Opus Homes — the same trio behind SouthCal in Caledon and The Castle Mile in Brampton.

Quick facts: Builders Arista Homes, Deco Homes, Opus Homes. Product focus detached-home collection (expected, unconfirmed). Intersection Weston Road & Teston Road. City Vaughan (Woodbridge), Ontario. Ownership structure freehold expected, based on comparable builder projects. Starting price to be announced. Status Coming Soon — VIP Registration Open.

Bridgelands is a "Coming Soon" master-planned community near Weston Road and Teston Road in Woodbridge, a neighbourhood within the City of Vaughan, Ontario, developed by a partnership of Arista Homes, Deco Homes, and Opus Homes. This site focuses specifically on what is known — and not yet known — about a potential detached-home collection within the community.

While Bridgelands' exact home types have not been officially confirmed, the same three-builder partnership has a track record of including detached homes alongside townhomes in its other joint GTA communities. SouthCal, near Hurontario Street and Highway 410 in Caledon, and The Castle Mile, at 9491 The Gore Road in Brampton's Castlemore area, both feature detached-home offerings, with The Castle Mile in particular noted for expansive ravine lots.

The Castle Mile's mixed detached and townhome collection ranged from 1,583 to 4,050 square feet, which offers a rough sense of the scale these builders typically work at — though this is general context, not a confirmed size range for any future Bridgelands detached-home product.

As of August 2026, no detached-home floor plans, lot widths, or pricing have been released for Bridgelands. Buyers interested specifically in the detached format can register here for priority notification the moment the builders confirm what's included in the community's product mix.

Pages that treat Bridgelands as one undifferentiated new community in Woodbridge leave a single-family buyer without a place to stand. This site exists for the detached-home question. It does not impersonate the builders and it does not invent a lot schedule. Townhome product is covered at bridgelandstowns.ca. Builder backgrounds and the full area guide live at bridgelands-woodbridge.ca.

A detached lot at a master-planned community is a different purchase from a townhome even when both sit on the same street grid. Bridgelands has not confirmed the detached product, the lot widths, or the tenure. Freehold is the working assumption only because SouthCal and The Castle Mile used it. VIP registration does not reserve a lot, lock a price, or collect a deposit.

## Collections — https://bridgelandsdetached.com/collections

A specific detached-home collection has not yet been confirmed for Bridgelands. Based on the builder trio's comparable communities, a detached offering — potentially spanning multiple lot widths or configurations — is a reasonable expectation pending official release.

Exact sizes for a Bridgelands detached-home collection have not been released. For general context, The Castle Mile's mixed detached and townhome product from the same builder trio ranged from 1,583 to 4,050 square feet, with some homes on expansive ravine lots — this is general context, not a confirmed size range for Bridgelands.

Lot widths for a Bridgelands detached-home collection have not been officially confirmed. The builder trio's other joint communities have offered a range of detached lot widths, but no specific figures have been published for Bridgelands.

Detached Home Collection (expected) — Lot widths, sizes, and pricing not yet confirmed. Comparable product from the same builder trio at The Castle Mile ranged 1,583–4,050 sq ft across its full mixed collection, with some homes on expansive ravine lots. Register for release notification.

Arista Homes, Deco Homes, and Opus Homes have not published a Bridgelands detached brochure, elevation set, lot schedule, or site plan that names single-family homes as of August 29, 2026. The reason this page still discusses a detached collection is the trio's other joint work at SouthCal and The Castle Mile. Those two communities are not Bridgelands, and their plans are not transferable.

When a three-builder community does include detached homes, the offering is often split by lot width or by which partner constructs which street. That division has not been disclosed for Bridgelands.

What to watch for at release: a published lot schedule that names detached homes; lot width bands, not just square footage; and which builder constructs the singles.

## Pricing — https://bridgelandsdetached.com/pricing

Pricing for Bridgelands detached homes has not yet been announced. As comparable context only, The Castle Mile — from the same builder trio — offered a mixed detached and townhome collection ranging from 1,583 to 4,050 square feet; this is not a price or size guarantee for Bridgelands.

No deposit structure has been published for Bridgelands, including for a potential detached-home collection, as of August 2026. Registered buyers are typically notified of deposit terms once VIP pricing is released.

Starting price, deposit structure, maintenance fees, tentative occupancy, incentives, and lot widths / sizes are all to be announced.

A price for a Bridgelands detached home cannot be stated because the builders have not released one. Comparable communities are useful for scale and useless for a budget. Maintenance fees on a true freehold detached lot are typically limited to municipal taxes and any parcel-of-tied-land arrangement. Occupancy is to be announced. The Castle Mile has been described by a third-party source as set to complete in 2025; that timeline does not describe Bridgelands.

Prices, sizes, specifications, and availability are subject to change without notice. E.&O.E. Information current as of August 29, 2026.

## Location — https://bridgelandsdetached.com/location

Bridgelands is located near Weston Road and Teston Road in Woodbridge, Vaughan, Ontario, roughly a 10–13 minute drive from Maple GO Station.

Bridgelands and SouthCal are separate communities from the same builder trio — Arista Homes, Deco Homes, and Opus Homes — in different cities (Vaughan vs. Caledon). SouthCal's detached offering is in active pre-construction registration; a Bridgelands detached collection has not yet been confirmed or priced.

Transit: A third-party source places Bridgelands roughly a 10–13 minute drive from Maple GO Station, with a GO train ride to Toronto's Union Station of approximately 34 minutes, and close to Highways 400, 407, and 427.

Shopping and healthcare: Vaughan Mills Mall is cited by a third-party source as roughly an 8–11 minute drive away, and Cortellucci Vaughan Hospital as roughly a 7-minute drive away.

Schools: Nearby schools cited by a third-party source include Tommy Douglas Secondary School, Johnny Lombardi Public School, Teston Village Public School, Maple High School, and St. Joan of Arc Catholic High School. Exact catchment boundaries for Bridgelands have not been independently confirmed. For the full location breakdown including parks, recreation, and the complete school and healthcare context, see bridgelands-woodbridge.ca/location.

Recreation cited by a third-party source: North Maple Regional Park, Eagles Nest Golf Club, Copper Creek Golf Club, Chatfield District Park, Nashville Conservation Reserve, Maple Downs Golf & Country Club, Mackenzie Glen District Park, Wildberry Pond, Cold Creek Conservation Area, Maple Nature Reserve Trail.

Comparison:
- Bridgelands — Weston Rd & Teston Rd, Woodbridge — Expected, unconfirmed
- SouthCal — Hurontario St & Hwy 410, Caledon — Active — detached homes in pre-construction
- The Castle Mile — 9491 The Gore Rd, Castlemore (Brampton) — Detached homes on ravine lots, 1,583–4,050 sq ft mixed collection, completing 2025

SouthCal is the live comparable for a buyer who wants detached product from this trio today. It is in Caledon. Bridgelands is in Vaughan. The two sites do not share a price list, a lot fabric, or a launch date. The Castle Mile is the size-and-lot comparable, not the timeline comparable.

## Register — https://bridgelandsdetached.com/register

Registering for VIP access to Bridgelands detached-home updates is free, takes under a minute, and requires no phone call. Buyers submit first name, last name, email, phone, and whether they are a licensed real estate agent, plus CASL consent.

## Privacy — https://bridgelandsdetached.com/privacy

This independent site collects registration fields to notify buyers when detached-home details are released. Records are stored with Supabase. Deletion requests: privacy@bridgelandsdetached.com (generic Privacy Requests alias). PIPEDA and CASL apply. Analytics identifiers remain inactive until supplied.
